sources.summary:
OpenAI's GPT-6.2 Astra and Sol give much shorter, more direct answers than their predecessors, but they are also less willing to admit uncertainty. Anthropic's Claude models score well ahead on transparency.
OpenAI's GPT-6.2 Astra and Sol give much shorter, more direct answers than their predecessors, but they are also less willing to admit uncertainty. Anthropic's Claude models score well ahead on transparency.
An Artificial Analysis evaluation shows how much OpenAI's communication style has ch
sources.recommend_reason_zh: Artificial Analysis评估显示，GPT-6.2 Astra平均回答从352词降至210词、Sol从337降至223词，但Astra的Admits Uncertainty分数从96跌至24、Sol从98降至51，透明度指数41和57远低于Claude的81和90。

en.reason: Artificial Analysis found GPT-6.2 Astra's average answer length fell from 352 to 210 words and Sol's from 337 to 223, but Astra's Admits Uncertainty score dropped from 96 to 24 and Sol's from 98 to 51, leaving their transparency indices of 41 and 57 far below Claude's 81 and 90.

stories.title: 智能体企业新前沿：驱动高效智能

sources.title: 智能体企业新前沿：驱动高效智能
sources.title_zh: 智能体企业新前沿：驱动高效智能
sources.title_original: 智能体企业新前沿：驱动高效智能
sources.summary:
智能体企业新前沿：驱动高效智能在这场开场主题演讲中，Snowflake CEO Sridhar Ramaswamy 与产品执行副总裁 Christian Kleinerman 将分享 Snowflake 如何依托开放、受治理的数据基础，助力企业构建智能体企业，实现高效智能。通过跨职能场景的现场演示和《财富》500强企业高管的实践洞察，他们将展示业务团队与技术团队如何在实际工作场景中有效采取行动。

en.title: The New Frontier for Agentic Enterprises: Driving Efficient Intelligence
en.summary:
The New Frontier of the Agentic Enterprise: Powering Efficient Intelligence

In this opening keynote, Snowflake CEO Sridhar Ramaswamy and Executive Vice President of Product Christian Kleinerman will share how Snowflake helps enterprises build the agentic enterprise on an open, governed data foundation to deliver efficient intelligence. Through live demonstrations of cross-functional scenarios and insights from Fortune 500 executives, they will show how business and technical teams can take effective action in real-world work.
en.reason: Snowflake CEO Sridhar Ramaswamy and product EVP Christian Kleinerman show how an open, governed data foundation helps enterprises build agentic businesses, using cross-functional live demos and Fortune 500 executive insights.

打造 AI 优先的销售与营销运营体系构建 AI 优先的销售与营销组织，需要哪些条件?Snowflake 首席营销官 DenisePersson 和首席营收官 Jon Beaulier 将探讨如何协同团队、整合业务数据，并明确职责分工，让 AI 真正发挥作用。现场还将演示如何使用 Snowflake CoWork 解答业务问题，并分享 Snowflake 团队在推动 AI 应用、衡量实际成效方面的经验。Canva 首席客户官 RobGiglio 也将加入对话，分享他对团队管理、营销与销售协同，以及 AI 未来机遇的见解。

en.title: Building an AI-first sales and marketing operations system
en.summary: Building an AI-first sales and marketing operating model: What does it take to build an AI-first sales and marketing organization? Snowflake CMO DenisePersson and Chief Revenue Officer Jon Beaulier will discuss how to align teams, integrate business data, and clarify responsibilities so AI can truly deliver. There will also be a live demo of using Snowflake CoWork to answer business questions, plus lessons from the Snowflake team on driving AI adoption and measuring real-world results. Canva Chief Customer Officer RobGiglio will join the conversation to share his views on team management, marketing-sales alignment, and future opportunities for AI.
en.reason: Snowflake CMO Denise Persson and CRO Jon Beaulier discuss aligning teams, consolidating business data and clarifying ownership for AI-first sales and marketing organizations, with a live demo of Snowflake CoWork answering business questions and Canva CCO Rob Giglio joining on team management and AI opportunities.

sources.summary: 反复提醒 AI“想清楚再做、交付前检查”，结果它还是会跑偏？作者把以终为始、二八法则、逆向思考等 12 条做事常识，改写成 Agent 能执行的具体规则：什么情况下该追问、何时停下重查、交付前必须验证什么。或许会有所帮助！
sources.recommend_reason_zh: 文章来自Flomo联合创始人Light的付费专栏，尝试把12条知识工作者的底层常识改写成Agent能执行的规则，比如以终为始要求动手前先对齐目标和验收标准。

en.title: Universal wisdom for you and your Agent: 12 foundational common-sense principles and execution rules for knowledge workers (with open-source Skill uw-mode)
en.summary: Keep reminding AI to "think it through before acting and check before delivering," yet it still goes off the rails? The author rewrote 12 everyday working principles—begin with the end in mind, the 80/20 rule, reverse thinking—into concrete rules an Agent can execute: when to ask follow-up questions, when to stop and recheck, and what must be verified before delivery. It might just help!
en.reason: Flomo co-founder Light’s paid column converts 12 knowledge-worker principles—including begin with the end in mind, the 80/20 rule and inversion—into executable Agent rules for when to ask follow-ups, pause and recheck, and verify before delivery.

stories.title: 循环工程与图工程：让智能体独立运行的完整指南

sources.title: 循环工程与图工程：让智能体独立运行的完整指南
sources.title_zh: 循环工程与图工程：让智能体独立运行的完整指南
sources.title_original: 循环工程与图工程：让智能体独立运行的完整指南
sources.summary: 这套Agent工程方案提出了一个“循环+依赖图”双层架构，可以解决开发者逐行审核、沦为流程瓶颈的痛点。
sources.recommend_reason_zh: 文章以从 JavaScript 迁移到 TypeScript 为例，讲智能体独立运行的两层：循环靠 check.sh 跑 tsc、vitest 和 git diff 校验，失败回传报错重试；图工程负责拆分任务、排清依赖，避免用 any 填类型缺口。

en.title: Loop Engineering and Graph Engineering: A Complete Guide to Running Agents Autonomously
en.summary: This Agent engineering approach proposes a dual-layer "loop + dependency graph" architecture to solve the pain point of developers reviewing line by line and becoming a bottleneck in the process.
en.reason: Using a JavaScript-to-TypeScript migration as its example, the guide explains a two-layer agent architecture: check.sh runs tsc, vitest and git diff to catch failures and retry, while dependency graphs split tasks and avoid any-typing gaps.

sources.title_en: Upload2Shell (CVE-2026-125396)
sources.title_original: Upload2Shell (CVE-2026-125396)
sources.recommend_reason_zh: 文章披露 Ghostscript Type 1 字体加载器的 use-after-free（CVE-2026-125396）可绕过 -dSAFER，并在 Google 文档渲染、WordPress 上传、Debian 13 的 IPP 队列和 Roundcube 缩略图路径中确认执行命令，上游修复对应 Artifex Bug 709684。

en.reason: A use-after-free in Ghostscript’s Type 1 font loader (CVE-2026-125396) bypasses -dSAFER to execute attacker-chosen commands, with confirmed command execution in Google Docs rendering, WordPress uploads, Debian 13 IPP queues and Roundcube thumbnails, fixed by Artifex Bug 709684.

stories.title: AI Agent 如何进入实时交易系统：货拉拉的三个实践与一套工程方法论

sources.title: AI Agent 如何进入实时交易系统：货拉拉的三个实践与一套工程方法论
sources.title_zh: AI Agent 如何进入实时交易系统：货拉拉的三个实践与一套工程方法论
sources.title_original: AI Agent 如何进入实时交易系统：货拉拉的三个实践与一套工程方法论
sources.summary:
当 AI Agent 从“回答问题”走向“直接改变业务状态”，真正的挑战不再是模型能不能思考，而是它能否在实时交易系统里可靠地行动，并带来可衡量的业务结果。
作者： 亓隆基（Laurence Qi），货拉拉技术总监
摘要： 当 AI Agent 从“回答问题”走向“直接改变业务状态”，真正的挑战不再是模型能不能思考，而是它能否在实时交易系统里可靠地行动，并带来可衡量的业务结果。本文基于货拉拉在意图交易（AI 下单）、持续撮合（司机 Agent / AI 撮合）和策略执行（AI 运营）三个场景的生产实践，讨论 Agent 与成熟的机器学习、运筹优化和交易系统如何分工，并提出一套面向生产系统的工程方法论——Agent 生产化四层模型：模型决定起点，Harness 决定下限，Dual Loop 决定方向，业务知识决定上限。
关键词： AI Agent；实时交易系统；Harness Engineering；上下文工程；Multi-Agent；评测闭环
过去三年，行业为了让 Agent 真正完成任务投入了大量努力：模型更强，上下文更长，工具更多。但对一家业务公司来说，有一个问题却越来越难回答——
sources.recommend_reason_zh: 货拉拉基于意图交易、持续撮合和AI运营三个生产实践，提出Agent生产化四层模型，并披露意图识别准确率99%、选车正确率93%、新客下单时长缩短25%。

en.title: How AI Agents Enter Real-Time Trading Systems: Huolala's Three Practices and an Engineering Methodology
en.reason: HuoLaLa technical director Laurence Qi details three production AI agent deployments—intent-based ordering, driver-side continuous matching, and AI operations—reporting 99% intent recognition accuracy, 93% vehicle-selection accuracy and 25% shorter order-placement time for new customers, plus a four-layer Agent productionization model spanning models, Harness, Dual Loop and business knowledge.

sources.summary:
AI 编程的下一场战争，不在模型，在协议 过去一年，AI 编程工具的竞争出现了一个反直觉的变化。 模型能力还在涨，但决定一个工具能不能进入团队工作流的，越来越不是模型，而是它能不能接上你已有的工具、前
过去一年，AI 编程工具的竞争出现了一个反直觉的变化。
模型能力还在涨，但决定一个工具能不能进入团队工作流的，越来越不是模型，而是它能不能接上你已有的工具、前端和技能。
你换一个更聪明的 Agent，结果它连不上你的 MCP server；你想把执行过程推到现有前端，发现每接一个端都要重写一套状态映射；你写好的团队规范，换一个工具就全部失效。
这不是模型的问题。这是协议层的问题。
这篇文章拆三层：MCP、AG-UI、Agent Skills，以及三个具体项目：AG-UI、Chrome DevTools MCP、stitch-skills。每个项目对应一个不同的缺口，也各自暴露了协议层现在的真实成熟度。
先给结论：
MCP 标准化“工具怎么被调用”，AG-UI 标准化“过程怎么被看见”，Agent Skills 标准化“能力怎么被携带”。
这三层不是替代关系，是组合关系。理解这一点，比记住
sources.recommend_reason_zh: 文章拆解MCP、AG-UI、Agent Skills三层协议，借Linux基金会将Anthropic MCP、OpenAI AGENTS.md、Block goose收进中立托管平台及AG-UI约27种标准事件等细节，说明AI编程竞争正从模型转向协议。

en.title: The next battle in AI coding isn't over models — it's over protocols
en.summary:
The Next AI Coding Battle Isn’t About Models—It’s About Protocols

Over the past year, competition among AI coding tools has seen a counterintuitive shift. Model capabilities keep improving, but what increasingly determines whether a tool can enter a team’s workflow is not the model—it’s whether it can connect to your existing tools, frontends, and skills.

You switch to a smarter Agent, only to find it can’t connect to your MCP server. You want to push the execution process to an existing frontend and discover that every endpoint you integrate requires rewriting a set of state mappings. Your team conventions, once written, all become useless when you switch tools.

This is not a model problem. It is a protocol-layer problem.

This article breaks the problem into three layers—MCP, AG-UI, and Agent Skills—and three specific projects: AG-UI, Chrome DevTools MCP, and stitch-skills. Each project addresses a different gap and reveals the real current maturity of the protocol layer.

The conclusion up front:
MCP standardizes how tools are invoked, AG-UI standardizes how the process is made visible, and Agent Skills standardizes how capabilities are carried.
These three layers are not substitutes; they compose. Understanding this matters more than memorization.

做 AI 产品创业这几年，最直观的感受是：产品迭代速度，经常被设计环节卡住。
小团队养不起专职设计师，产品经理自己画原型，不规范、不成体系，开发还原全靠猜；有设计团队的公司，需求到设计反复拉扯，组件规范对齐、多页面风格统一要耗掉大量沟通成本。市面上的 AI 绘图工具倒是很多，生成的效果图很惊艳，但一到落地就懵——和自家设计系统对不上、没法直接拆成可用组件，最后还是要设计师重画一遍。
说白了，绝大多数 AI 设计工具，解决的都是「好不好看」的问题，没解决**「能不能落地」**的问题。
也是在这样的背景下， LangChain 团队开源的 Design Agent 走进了我的视野。它不是又一个 AI 生图工具，而是一套基于 Agent 架构的设计执行系统：懂你的设计系统、用你的组件库、遵循你的业务规则，最终输出的不是一张孤立的效果图，而是可落地的设计方案，甚至能直接对接设计工具、生成对应前端
sources.recommend_reason_zh: LangChain 开源的 Design Agent 不做开放式 AI 生图，而是把设计规范和组件库注入 Agent，输出可编辑源文件乃至前端代码，解决 AI 设计难落地的问题。

en.title: A Deep Dive into Design Agent: LangChain's AI Design Moves from "Good-Looking" to "Usable
en.summary:
Over the past few years building AI products, my most immediate takeaway has been that product iteration speed is often bottlenecked by design. Small teams can’t afford dedicated designers, so product managers draw prototypes themselves—inconsistent and unstructured—and developers are left guessing how to implement them. Companies with design teams get stuck in endless back-and-forth from requirements to design; aligning component standards and unifying styles across multiple pages eats up huge amounts of communication. There are plenty of AI drawing tools on the market, and the mockups they generate look stunning, but when it comes to production, teams are lost—they don’t match the company’s design system and can’t be broken down into usable components, so designers end up redrawing everything.

Put simply, most AI design tools solve the “does it look good” problem, not the “can it ship” problem.

Against this backdrop, the Design Agent open-sourced by the LangChain team came onto my radar. It’s not another AI image-generation tool, but an Agent-architecture-based design execution system: it understands your design system, uses your component library, follows your business rules, and ultimately outputs not an isolated mockup but a shippable design plan—one that can even connect directly to design tools and generate the corresponding frontend.
en.reason: LangChain's open-source Design Agent skips open-ended AI image generation, instead injecting design specs and component libraries into the agent so it outputs editable source files and even frontend code, addressing why AI design tools stall at implementation.

平时很多朋友用 AI Agent 写网页或者做应用界面，经常会遇到两个情况。
第一个是做单页的时候，如果你只是简单跟它说「帮我做一个某某产品的网站，做得好看一点」，出来的页面往往带着很重的默认模板感。
除了早期的蓝紫色渐变和左右分栏，现在的模型还很喜欢在每个标题上面加一个英文胶囊小标签，底下配一段没什么实际信息的灰色解释小字，再在大圆角卡片里套一层小卡片。只要你不给具体的限制，它就会退回到这种最稳妥、最不容易出错的写法。

en.title: This open-source design Skill pushes AI's design capabilities to the limit (Oil UI)
en.summary:
Drawing on gallery-tested pieces and real-world website redesign projects, here’s a look at the four process considerations behind the open-source interface design Skill Oil UI—type-based routing, comparing directions first, resolving spec conflicts, and context-free screenshot checks—plus how to use it day to day.

Many people using AI Agents to build web pages or app interfaces run into two common situations.

First, when building a single page, if you simply ask it to build a website for some product and make it look good, the output often has a heavy default-template feel. Beyond the early blue-purple gradients and left-right split layouts, today’s models love adding an English pill-shaped tag above every heading, a line of small gray explanatory text with little real information underneath, and a small card nested inside a large rounded card. Unless you give specific constraints, it falls back to this safest, least error-prone approach.

Second, even if the first page is barely whipped into shape, when you open a new conversation to keep building the second page, or iterate back and forth in an old project, button corner radii, spacing, and colors start drifting again.

Recently, I organized my usual interface-building workflow and open-sourced a design Skill called Oil UI. I also built a gallery site, ui.oiloil.org, showcasing interactive work generated by different models. Many people using AI Agents to build web pages or app interfaces run into two common situations.

First, when building a single page, if you simply ask it to build a website for some product and make it look good, the output often has a heavy default-template feel. Beyond the early blue-purple gradients and left-right split layouts, today’s models love adding an English pill-shaped tag above every heading, a line of small gray explanatory text with little real information underneath, and a small card nested inside a large rounded card. Unless you give specific constraints, it falls back to this safest, least error-prone approach.

Second, even if the first page is barely whipped into shape, when you open a new conversation to keep building the second page, or iterate back and forth in an old project, button corner radii, spacing, and colors start drifting again.

Recently, I organized my usual interface-building workflow and open-sourced a design Skill called Oil UI. I also built a gallery site, ui.oiloil.org, showcasing interactive work generated by different models. sources.title_en: America, China, and the Costs of the Bipolar AI Race
sources.title_original: America, China, and the Costs of the Bipolar AI Race
sources.recommend_reason_zh: 文章以Epoch AI数据揭示AI双极格局：2022年至2026年6月U.S.获全球新增AI算力约72%、China获10%，其余国家合计仅18%，并追问这种集中如何削弱多数国家对AI建设、测试与治理的话语权。

en.reason: Epoch AI data showing the U.S. captured roughly 72% of new global AI compute from 2022 to June 2026 and China 10%, leaving all other countries just 18%, frames this argument that the Washington-Beijing rivalry leaves most nations with little say over how AI is built, tested, and governed.
